name: Handpainted Reference Image Inversion
definition: A task where a rendering model learns to reproduce a user-edited 2D reference image from a 3D volume, demonstrating the ability to learn complex classification features that are difficult to define with traditional multidimensional transfer functions.
summary: Handpainted Reference Image Inversion trains volume rendering models to replicate complex semantic colorization from user-edited 2D images, bypassing tedious manual transfer function adjustments.
